data.title: 大正海滨电车的旧书页

data.animaCaption: Seated on the green velvet bench of a coastal wooden tram in a lavender camellia kimono and deep purple hakama, she rests an open book on her lap while tapping the window glass to show you the sparkling sea. Bright ocean reflections ripple across the lacquered wood and her silver hair.
data.promptProse: Captured from the adjacent seat inside a classic wooden coastal tram, Ayachi Nene sits beside wide sunlit windows wearing a Taisho-era lavender kimono top patterned with delicate camellias, a pleated deep-purple hakama, and brown lace-up boots. An old thread-bound book lies open across her knees while she raises one hand to lightly tap the glass, turning toward the viewer with a serene smile as the sparkling blue ocean glides past outside. Sunbeams filtered through the wooden window mullions cast rhythmic bands of warm light and shimmering sea reflections over the green plush seat and her hair.
data.story: 老式木头电车咣当咣当地沿着海岸线晃动。换上复古袴装的宁宁膝上摊着刚从旧书街淘来的诗集，看见窗外豁然展开的碎金海面，轻轻叩响玻璃回头唤你——「快看外面！刚才那片海光，简直像把星星揉进水里了。」
